subject.title: feat(xiaomi): expose MiMo V2.5 on pay-as-you-go and default to mimo-v2.5

question: Should OpenClaw change Xiaomi pay-as-you-go and Token Plan fresh onboarding defaults to `mimo-v2.5`, or narrow this PR to catalog-only V2.5 availability?
rationale: The code stays in the correct plugin/docs boundary and Xiaomi docs support V2.5 as the Flash replacement, but provider defaults are an upgrade-sensitive product choice that automation should not approve implicitly.

options.title: Sponsor V2.5 Defaults
options.body: Accept the PR's default flip for fresh/no-primary Xiaomi setup after conflict resolution and own the user-visible model-selection change.

options.title: Request Catalog-Only Rows
options.body: Keep the PAYG V2.5 catalog/docs/test additions but leave existing Xiaomi defaults unchanged for now.

options.title: Pause Behind #87277
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader Xiaomi V2.5 and multimodal-routing issue settles the catalog/default split.

recommendation.title: Sponsor V2.5 Defaults
recommendation.body: Accept the PR's default flip for fresh/no-primary Xiaomi setup after conflict resolution and own the user-visible model-selection change.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the closest merged Token Plan/V2.5 catalog and onboarding work affected by this default decision.
